title: Straight-line program circuit
statement: For a straight-line program on $n$ inputs, form a directed acyclic circuit whose gates are the program's gates in order, appending a constant-false gate when the program has no statements. Its output vertex is $2n+(m-1)$, where $m$ is the program length.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of program length, gate translation, and the constant gate, so their exact conventions are not fully specified.
